CasePathwayFitResponse.description:
The source-coverage signal the Cases screen renders. Only the two fields
the frontend declares are served; sources.domain.pathway_fit computes more,
and the rest stay internal rather than widening the wire speculatively.
CasePathwayFitResponse.title: CasePathwayFitResponse

FilingReceiptResponse.description:
The detached filing receipt: who approved the exact frozen bytes and
when, bound to every digest the approval consumed. Never inside the bytes.
FilingReceiptResponse.title: FilingReceiptResponse

FreezeJobResponse.description:
A freeze waiting for, running in, or finished by the worker. The frozen
record itself appears in `frozen_history` only once the job is PUBLISHED.
FreezeJobResponse.title: FreezeJobResponse

HealthResponse.description:
Liveness *and* readiness on one route. The booleans name which subsystem
is down and nothing more — /api/health is the only unauthenticated route, so
it never serves a path, a DSN, a build id, or an exception message.
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

IntakeDocumentResponse.description:
One manifest row per uploaded file: what the host classified it as, how
it is used, and why — machine suggestions from prepared evidence, never
authority taken from the document.
IntakeDocumentResponse.title: IntakeDocumentResponse

IntakeResponse.description:
The durable intake record: case, run, manifest, route and any typed
clarification. `run` is the same strict run projection the run routes
serve; `refusal` is set for `clarification` and `execution_unavailable`.
IntakeResponse.title: IntakeResponse

OpinionResponse.description:
One analyst opinion sign-off (Task 10): append-only, digest-bound to the
exact draft revision and every authority it depends on.
OpinionResponse.title: OpinionResponse

RVQuickRow.description:
The quick-paste twin of contracts.RVRow, and it carries the same two
boundary rules: text is NFC-normalized and control-free, numbers are finite.
Without the finite check a JSON `Infinity` parses, serializes back to the
analyst as `null`, and lands in the rv_universes JSON column as a literal
`Infinity` — invalid JSON that a Postgres json column refuses outright.
RVQuickRow.title: RVQuickRow

ResearchPlanResponse.description:
The host-proposed plan exactly as reviewed; its canonical digest is the
approval hash (invariant 5). Served only on DEEP_RESEARCH runs.
ResearchPlanResponse.title: ResearchPlanResponse

SignOpinionRequest.description:
Analyst opinion sign-off (Task 10, DECISIONS §14.19): binds the exact
draft revision; every statement is required and explicit ("None" is written,
never left blank); the head CAS is the caller's expected current opinion.
SignOpinionRequest.title: SignOpinionRequest

schema.title: Response List Cases Api Cases Get

get.description:
The case's audit package as a zip (binary, OpenAPI-exempt like the
other downloads). Everything inside is host-owned metadata, digests and
the exact filed bytes; nothing is a secret, a prompt or source text.

post.description:
Validates and queues the freeze; the worker publishes every export
and writes the frozen record, which then appears in `frozen_history`.

get.description:
Case-scoped issuer lens: identity plus the visible snapshot's authority
identifiers (the visible lens follows the accepted pointer until pinned).

post.description:
One governed mutation provisions a distinct approver. The store owns
the rule: the actor must hold case ADMIN/APPROVER standing or the current
global ADMIN role; non-members never learn the case exists.

schema.title: Response List Notes Api Cases  Case Id  Notes Get

get.description:
The case's snapshot lens: `accepted` is what the analyst sees now,
`latest_accepted` the newest acceptance. Until an explicit switch pins a
snapshot, the visible lens follows the accepted pointer; once pinned,
only /snapshot/switch moves it and divergence surfaces as switch_required.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api Cases  Case Id  Sources Get

post.description:
One strict multipart transaction: `files` (one or more) and an
optional `case_id`. Admission stays in prepare_upload; the service
orchestrates the domain services and never another route.

get.description:
Thin SSE tail of the append-only run_events log (DECISIONS §5): legacy
event names verbatim, `id:` carries the per-run sequence so Last-Event-ID
reconnects resume without replay. The stream closes once a terminal run is
fully delivered; live runs hold it open with keepalive comments.
